data.cultural_impact: The name Arlie, having its origin in Greek, was traditionally given to a farmer or someone who was engaged in agricultural work. Regardless of its origins, this name reflects a strong connection with the land, rustic charm, and a basic, honest livelihood. Arlie can bring to mind the images of hardworking farmers, sun-kissed fields, and a simple, unhurried lifestyle.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Arlie embodies the virtues of commitment, diligence, and humility.
